company_info.description: Heian Ceremony Service Co.,Ltd. provides services related to weddings, funerals, and other services in Japan. The company provides weddings, receptions, various banquets, wedding beauty services; general beauty services; photo studios, wedding venue information, honeymoon consultations, memorial services, fresh flowers, wreaths, printing; and consulting services. It is also involved in costume rentals, various event implementation, wedding gift sales, catering, restaurants, outcall parties, funeral, various commemorative ceremony contracts; and sales of Buddhist altars and Buddhist altar implements; rental halls and costumes; nursing care and logistics business; cemetery and gravestone arrangements; and mutual aid association business . The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Hiratsuka, Japan.
